title: boehmeria nivea subsp. nipononivea
intro: Boehmeria nivea subsp. nipononivea, commonly known as Japanese mulberry, is a plant species belonging to the nettle family (Urticaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an antiseptic and antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria nivea subsp. nipononivea include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of this plant are due to its ability to protect against oxidative stress, improve lipid profiles, and regulate blood sugar levels.
